## Core model

RNA-seq differential expression is count-based. DESeq2 estimates size factors, dispersions, and condition effects from raw integer counts.

## Teaching caveats

- Two replicates per condition are a minimal teaching design, not an ideal study.
- PCA is a diagnostic for sample-level structure.
- MA and volcano plots summarize effect size and uncertainty; neither replaces biological interpretation.

## Common invalid inputs

Do not use TPM, FPKM, CPM coverage, or bigWig values as DESeq2 input.
